question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

The shells that were collected from the seashore are kept on the shelf as a __reminder of the place.__
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) souvenir.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **souvenir **is an object that is kept as a reminder of a place or an event.
 
• In the given sentence, the shells collected from the seashore are kept as a reminder of the place.
